case.name: krea-first-segment
case.scope: One unchanged fixed Krea step0/segment0, saved provided-text/noise/rope fixtures and sigma=1. Three exact original Swift F32 carries, including94.5MiB image_1. No full generation, encoder, scheduler update or decoder. Both paired arms omit the reshape hint because public Python b3 cannot set it; production/retained acceptance uses explicit true. Exact correctness under the omitted hint remains to be tested; do not relax the output gate.

float16_conversions.conversion: Exact little-endian binary32 -> binary16, round-to-nearest ties-to-even; signed zeros preserved; no scaling, clipping or axis permutation.

provenance.packing: C-order flatten84*48 rows to4032 rows; same scalar order as existing Krea driver halves(), no axis permutation.

quiet_window: User reserved GPU after completing/stopping Aether work. No benchmark GPU concurrency or cache purge. Recorded cooldown is experimental spacing, not fixed clocks or controlled ambient temperature.
